title: Stateful confirmed sequence ending in ReadProperty
purpose: Exercise sequential confirmed-request handling with distinct invoke IDs and related read services before a final ReadProperty request, improving stateful transaction coverage over repeated identical stubs.
expected_behavior: Each message should parse as a complete BACnet/IP confirmed request. The first two exercise transaction bookkeeping and related service dispatch, and the third should dispatch to ReadProperty with a distinct invoke ID.
constraints_preserved: Each message contains complete BVLC plus NPDU plus APDU layering.
Every BVLC length field equals the actual byte count of its message.
NPDU version and control octets are present in each message.
All APDUs use confirmed-request type 0x00 in the high nibble.
Each confirmed APDU includes control, invoke ID, service choice, and payload bytes.
Invoke IDs vary monotonically across the sequence.
issue_safety_notes: Statefulness is limited to normal sequential request handling and invoke-ID variation. No issue claims or malformed sequencing are used.
